title: Mission Control AI Signal panel: remove developer labels (DETERMINISTIC MODE, BUILD LANE, PROVIDER, SIGNALS, REPAIRS)
goal: The Mission Control AI Signal panel (right column) shows multiple developer-facing labels that are visible to all operators: (1) 'DETERMINISTIC MODE' badge — internal implementation detail, remove or replace with 'Review Mode' or 'Supervised' for operator context. (2) 'NO RUN SELECTED' in a dark badge — acceptable but style as a soft empty state, not a system label. (3) 'PROVIDER', 'SIGNALS', 'REPAIRS', 'BUILD LANE' — these are internal section headings. Replace: PROVIDER → 'AI Provider', SIGNALS → 'Recent Signals', REPAIRS → 'Repair Suggestions', BUILD LANE → remove entirely (this is internal developer infrastructure). (4) 'AI is review-only and cannot mutate active runtime state.' — this is useful but phrased as a technical constraint. Rewrite to: 'AI analyses the run and suggests next steps. All suggestions need your approval.' (5) When no run is selected, show a single clean message: 'Select a run to see AI analysis.' instead of the current multi-label empty state.
scope: Visual audit 2026-05-03: screenshot 04-mission-control.png shows 'DETERMINISTIC MODE', 'NO RUN SELECTED', 'AI Operator Workbench', 'PROVIDER', 'SIGNALS', 'REPAIRS', 'BUILD LANE' as separate visible labels in the AI Signal panel. All are internal/developer terminology.
generation_reason: Visual audit 2026-05-03: AI Signal panel shows 7 developer-facing labels to operators — needs operator language throughout.
